DXC issue #1627 -- force include file
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/1627

WHAT TO LOOK FOR

Compare the two panes. Both are asked to force-include "forced.h",
which this shader needs -- it references FORCED_VALUE and defines it
nowhere.

DXC does not have the option at all:

    dxc failed : Unknown argument: '-include'

Clang, where HLSL support is being rebuilt, does have it -- it is just
not exposed by the dxc-compatible driver, so it needs -Xclang:

    -Xclang -include -Xclang forced.h

That pane gets a different error:

    <built-in>:2:10: fatal error: 'forced.h' file not found

which is the point. Compiler Explorer is single-file, so forced.h does
not exist here. DXC fails while parsing arguments, before any file is
looked for; Clang fails looking for the file, which means the flag was
accepted and acted on. The capability already exists -- what is
missing is a driver-level spelling of it.
